svg.title: CIMUtil - CIM/XML Instance & Profile Validation Sequence

g.text: CIMUtil - CIM/XML Instance & Profile Validation Sequence
Phase 1: Rule Expansion (Paths A and B)
The CIM/XML instance and split model paths begin with the same two-phase rule
expansion step in ValidatorUtil.expandRules(), which the validator's constructor
calls. The schema OntModel is used to resolve namespace prefixes and expand
schema-specific rule templates before the rules are applied to instance data.
The profile consistency path (Path C) parses profile.rules directly instead.
